activities.title: Colour Hunt
activities.description: Find safe objects around the room that match a sequence of colours.
steps: Choose a colour.
Find three safe objects of that colour without moving heavy items.
Return the objects or point them out, then choose another colour.
activities.safety_note: Use only visible, reachable objects; do not climb or open cupboards.

activities.title: Toy Sort Station
activities.description: Sort familiar toys by colour, size, type, or a rule the child invents.
steps: Place a small selection of safe toys on the floor.
Choose one sorting rule.
Make groups and explain what belongs in each group.
activities.safety_note: Use age-appropriate toys without loose small parts.

activities.title: Sock Matching Challenge
activities.description: Pair clean socks and arrange the pairs into patterns.
steps: Spread clean socks on the floor.
Find matching pairs.
Arrange the pairs from light to dark or small to large.
activities.safety_note: Use clean, dry socks in an uncluttered area.

activities.title: Pillow Path
activities.description: Follow a short floor-level path made from cushions and pillows.
steps: An adult places pillows on a clear floor.
Step from pillow to pillow without jumping from furniture.
Try the path slowly in reverse.
activities.safety_note: Adult supervision is required; keep the path on the floor and away from furniture edges.

activities.title: Animal Movement Game
activities.description: Move safely like different animals across a clear space.
steps: Choose an animal.
Copy its movement across a clear area.
Freeze, choose a new animal, and repeat.
activities.safety_note: Clear obstacles first and keep all movement at floor level.

activities.title: Torn-Paper Collage
activities.description: Tear paper into shapes and arrange them into an original picture.
steps: Tear paper into large safe pieces.
Arrange the pieces before gluing.
Glue the pieces and add drawn details if desired.
activities.safety_note: Use a non-toxic glue stick and paper only; no scissors are needed.

activities.title: Sticker Story
activities.description: Arrange stickers on paper and tell a story connecting the pictures.
steps: Choose three to six stickers.
Place them on the paper.
Tell or draw a beginning, middle, and ending.
activities.safety_note: Use large age-appropriate stickers and keep backing paper off the floor.

activities.title: Sound Detective
activities.description: Sit quietly and identify ordinary sounds from different directions.
steps: Sit in one safe place.
Listen quietly for one minute.
Name, draw, or write every sound you noticed.
activities.safety_note: Stay in the agreed safe area and do not investigate unfamiliar sounds alone.

activities.title: Shadow Shapes
activities.description: Use a flashlight to make hand or toy shadows on a wall.
steps: Dim the room while keeping the floor visible.
Point the flashlight at a blank wall.
Make shapes and observe how distance changes their size.
activities.safety_note: Never shine the light into anyone's eyes; keep walking areas visible.

activities.title: Cup Tower Lab
activities.description: Build and compare stable towers using lightweight plastic cups.
steps: Count the cups.
Build the tallest stable tower you can.
Try a wider design and compare which stays up longer.
activities.safety_note: Use only lightweight plastic or paper cups on the floor or a low table.

activities.title: Toy-Car Town Map
activities.description: Create floor roads and destinations for toy cars.
steps: Ask an adult where tape may be used.
Make simple roads on the floor.
Add paper destinations and drive a delivery route.
activities.safety_note: Use removable masking tape only with adult approval; keep roads out of walkways.

activities.title: Shape Scavenger List
activities.description: Find and record circles, rectangles, and other shapes in one room.
steps: Draw or write three target shapes.
Find safe objects matching each shape.
Record the objects without moving them.
activities.safety_note: Look only in the agreed room; do not climb or handle breakable objects.

activities.title: Draw a Treasure Map
activities.description: Invent a map with landmarks, a route, and a hidden imaginary treasure.
steps: Choose an imaginary place.
Draw at least five landmarks.
Add a safe route, symbols, and a map key.
activities.safety_note: The map is imaginative; do not hide objects or enter off-limit areas.

activities.title: Fold-and-Reveal Story
activities.description: Build a surprising story by revealing one prompt at a time.
steps: Fold paper into four sections.
In each section write or draw a character, place, problem, and solution.
Open the paper and connect everything into one story.
activities.safety_note: Use ordinary paper and writing tools in the agreed work area.

activities.title: Alphabet Category Hunt
activities.description: Name or write items in a chosen category for as many letters as possible.
steps: Choose a category such as animals or foods.
Start at A and name an item for each letter.
Skip difficult letters and return to them later.
activities.safety_note: Stay in the agreed location; this is a thinking game, not a physical search.

activities.title: Kindness Cards
activities.description: Create short appreciation cards for family members or friends.
steps: Choose someone to appreciate.
Draw or write one kind message.
Decorate the card and leave it for an adult to deliver.
activities.safety_note: Do not include addresses, phone numbers, or other private information.

activities.title: Paper Folding Challenge
activities.description: Explore how folds can turn one sheet into shapes and standing structures.
steps: Fold one sheet in half and reopen it.
Try accordion and triangle folds.
Create a paper shape that can stand on its own.
activities.safety_note: Use paper only; no cutting tools or staples are required.

activities.title: Four-Panel Comic
activities.description: Tell a complete visual story in four boxes.
steps: Divide the page into four panels.
Introduce a character and problem.
Show two events and finish with a solution.
activities.safety_note: Use the agreed desk or floor workspace and ordinary writing tools.

activities.title: Paper Pixel Pattern
activities.description: Design a small picture on a hand-drawn square grid.
steps: Draw an eight-by-eight grid.
Choose three colours.
Fill squares to create a symbol, creature, or repeating pattern.
activities.safety_note: Keep writing tools in the work area and pick them up after use.

activities.title: Build a Reading Nook
activities.description: Arrange a comfortable floor-level reading spot and choose a short reading mission.
steps: Choose a clear floor corner.
Arrange pillows without covering vents or doors.
Read one chapter or find five interesting facts.
activities.safety_note: Build only at floor level; never attach blankets to furniture, lights, or doors.

activities.title: Memory Tray
activities.description: Study safe objects, cover them, and recall as many as possible.
steps: An adult approves five to ten safe objects.
Study them for one minute.
Cover them and list or name everything remembered.
activities.safety_note: An adult must approve objects; exclude food, medicine, glass, tools, and small choking hazards.

activities.title: Nature Colour Chart
activities.description: Observe outdoor colours and record them without picking plants.
steps: Stay in the adult-approved outdoor area.
Find five colours in nature.
Make a colour mark and draw what showed each colour.
activities.safety_note: Observe only; do not touch unknown plants, insects, soil, or litter.

activities.title: Cloud Shape Journal
activities.description: Observe clouds from a safe place and draw changing shapes.
steps: Sit in an adult-approved shaded spot.
Watch one cloud for a short time.
Draw its shapes and write how they changed.
activities.safety_note: Never look at the sun; remain in shade and within the agreed boundary.

activities.title: Leaf Pattern Observer
activities.description: Compare fallen leaves by shape, edge, and vein pattern.
steps: Choose fallen leaves approved by an adult.
Draw their outlines and vein patterns.
Write or tell two similarities and differences.
activities.safety_note: Use only fallen leaves approved by an adult; wash hands afterward and avoid unknown plants.

activities.title: Chalk Hop Grid
activities.description: Draw a simple numbered grid and follow movement sequences.
steps: An adult approves a flat traffic-free surface.
Draw six large numbered squares.
Create and follow safe step-and-hop sequences.
activities.safety_note: Use a dry, level, traffic-free surface away from roads, steps, and vehicles.

activities.title: Balance Pose Countdown
activities.description: Hold a sequence of gentle floor-level balance poses.
steps: Stand in a clear flat area.
Try a comfortable one-foot pose near a wall without climbing.
Count to five, switch sides, and stop if uncomfortable.
activities.safety_note: Use a clear non-slip surface; stop immediately if dizzy or uncomfortable.

activities.title: Freeze Dance
activities.description: Move to music and freeze safely when it pauses.
steps: Clear a small movement area.
Play music at a comfortable volume.
Dance while it plays and freeze when it pauses.
activities.safety_note: Keep volume comfortable, feet on the floor, and the area clear of obstacles.

activities.title: Silent Charades Practice
activities.description: Act out safe everyday actions without words and prepare clues for later guessing.
steps: Choose five safe actions or animals.
Practice showing each using only gestures.
Write or draw a clue list for a family guessing round.
activities.safety_note: Use gentle floor-level gestures and avoid running, climbing, or pretending with dangerous objects.

activities.title: Paper-and-Cup Bridge
activities.description: Test how folded paper can span between two lightweight cups.
steps: Place two cups a short distance apart on a low table.
Lay paper across them and observe the sag.
Fold the paper in different ways and compare strength using one lightweight toy.
activities.safety_note: Use only lightweight cups and toys; do not test with heavy or breakable objects.

activities.title: Pre-cut Shape Puzzle
activities.description: Combine adult-prepared paper shapes into pictures and geometric designs.
steps: Spread out the adult-prepared shapes.
Arrange them into an animal, object, or repeating design.
Describe the shapes used or glue them with adult approval.
activities.safety_note: An adult prepares shapes beforehand; no cutting tool is part of the activity.

activities.title: Five-Senses Journal
activities.description: Record ordinary things noticed with sight, sound, touch, and smell.
steps: Stay in one adult-approved place.
Record one safe observation for sight, sound, touch, and smell.
Add a favourite detail; do not taste anything for this activity.
activities.safety_note: Do not taste items or touch or smell unknown substances, plants, or cleaning products.

activities.title: Calm Counting Pattern
activities.description: Use comfortable breathing and counting to make a short calming pattern.
steps: Sit comfortably in a safe place.
Breathe normally and count five breaths without holding them.
Notice five things you can see, then finish.
activities.safety_note: Breathe normally without breath-holding; stop if uncomfortable or dizzy.
